title: French Beef au Feu
description: A classic French dish made with tender beef cooked in a rich broth.

ingredients.name: Beef
ingredients.notes: Chewable beef cut, such as chuck or round

instructions: Heat the oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add the beef and cook until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
Remove the beef from the pot and set aside.
Add the onion, garlic, carrots, and celery to the pot and cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5 minutes.
Add the beef broth, thyme, and tomato paste (if using) to the pot.
Return the beef to the pot and bring the mixture to a boil.
Cover the pot and transfer it to the oven.
Braise the beef for 2 1/2 to 3 hours, or until it is tender.
Remove the pot from the oven and let it cool slightly.
Slice the beef and serve it with the sauce and vegetables.
